# omni-agent-skills

> A tool-neutral registry of focused skills, rules, and workflow assets for AI-assisted engineering.

## AI Discovery & Search
- Machine Index: `registry/registry.json`
- Semantic Q&A (RAG): `llms-qa.json`

## Skills

### Data And Ai
- ai-eval-benchmarker: Evaluates AI agent responses, tool invocation schemas, prompt regression suites, and model outputs against reproducible test cases. (registry/skills/data-and-ai/ai-eval-benchmarker/SKILL.md)
- rag-qa-chunking-engine: Transforms documentation, codebases, and technical knowledge bases into structured, high-relevance Q&A pair datasets (llms-qa.json) for semantic search and retrieval. (registry/skills/data-and-ai/rag-qa-chunking-engine/SKILL.md)

### Engineering
- atomic-feature-implementer: Executes minimal, focused code modifications strictly adhering to approved architecture plans, propagating callsite updates and preserving existing behavioral contracts. (registry/skills/engineering/atomic-feature-implementer/SKILL.md)
- clean-code-auditor: Audits git diffs and code modifications for code smells, DRY violations, adherence to repository conventions, and architectural consistency. (registry/skills/engineering/clean-code-auditor/SKILL.md)
- code-anti-overengineer: Simplifies over-engineered code, removes dead abstractions and redundant dependencies, flattens nested conditionals into early returns, and preserves exact behavioral contracts. (registry/skills/engineering/code-anti-overengineer/SKILL.md)
- pytest-verification-runner: Authors and executes unit, integration, and property-based verification test suites using Pytest and unittest to empirically catch regressions and validate invariants. (registry/skills/engineering/pytest-verification-runner/SKILL.md)
- semver-release-manager: Manages Semantic Versioning lifecycle, validates release metadata, updates changelogs, and orchestrates GitHub release workflows. (registry/skills/engineering/semver-release-manager/SKILL.md)
- system-architecture-planner: Analyzes system requirements, evaluates codebase dependencies, formulates architecture specifications, and scopes atomic implementation tasks. (registry/skills/engineering/system-architecture-planner/SKILL.md)

### Security And Governance
- advanced-verification-testing: Designs, implements, and executes multi-tier verification suites including unit, integration, golden snapshot regression, and property-based invariant testing. (registry/skills/security-and-governance/advanced-verification-testing/SKILL.md)
- ai-native-product-design: Architects software repositories and products for direct AI agent integration, tool exposure via protocols (MCP, OpenAPI), and structured discoverability. (registry/skills/security-and-governance/ai-native-product-design/SKILL.md)
- oss-launch-governance: Manages open-source pre-launch auditing, namespace availability verification, community governance documentation, and release readiness checklists. (registry/skills/security-and-governance/oss-launch-governance/SKILL.md)
- secret-leak-shield: Audits workspace edits and staged files for exposed API keys, private tokens, passwords, and sensitive environment variables to prevent accidental credential commits. (registry/skills/security-and-governance/secret-leak-shield/SKILL.md)
- tech-competitive-intelligence: Conducts objective technical competitive analysis, architectural positioning evaluations, trade-off matrices, and "Why Not X?" documentation. (registry/skills/security-and-governance/tech-competitive-intelligence/SKILL.md)

### Web And Geo
- a11y-web-auditor: Audits web applications for accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1), responsive layout behavior, semantic markup, and Core Web Vitals performance. (registry/skills/web-and-geo/a11y-web-auditor/SKILL.md)
- ai-first-web-geo: Structures web applications and documentation for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), RAG search indexing, and machine-readable context discovery. (registry/skills/web-and-geo/ai-first-web-geo/SKILL.md)
